claim.raw_value: the Company shall use reasonable best efforts to, shall cause its Subsidiaries to use reasonable best efforts to, and the Company shall use reasonable best efforts to cause its and its Subsidiaries’ respective Representatives to, provide such customary cooperation in connection with any debt and/or equity financing (including the Debt Financing) by Parent or any of its Subsidiaries or Affiliates in connection with the Transactions

Parent shall use its reasonable best efforts to take, or cause to be taken, all actions and do, or cause to be done all things reasonably necessary, proper or advisable to obtain the Debt Financing on or prior to the Closing Date
Parent shall use its reasonable best efforts to take, or cause to be taken, all actions to (w) comply with and maintain in effect the Commitment Letter

use reasonable best efforts to obtain alternative financing from the same or alternative debt financing sources on terms and conditions not materially less favorable to Parent, taken as a whole, than the terms and conditions set forth in the Commitment Letter
Parent and Titanium Merger Sub acknowledge and agree that the Closing is not conditioned upon Parent obtaining any financing.
deliver to Parent not later than two (2) business days (or such shorter period as reasonably agreed by Parent) prior to the Titanium Merger Effective Time
with drafts being delivered at least five (5) business days (or such shorter period as reasonably agreed by Parent) prior to the Titanium Merger Effective Time

use reasonable best efforts to obtain alternative financing from the same or alternative debt financing sources on terms and conditions not materially less favorable to Parent, taken as a whole, than the terms and conditions set forth in the Commitment Letter

attributes.why_unmapped: ALTERNATIVE_FINANCING: If the contemplated Debt Financing becomes unavailable, Parent must seek replacement debt financing on terms not materially less favorable, without additional conditions, sufficient to meet the Required Amount.

claim.raw_value: Parent may modify, supplement or amend the Commitment Letter to (1) add lenders, lead arrangers, bookrunners, syndication agents or similar entities that have not executed the Commitment Letter as of the date of this Agreement

attributes.why_unmapped: LENDER_ARRANGEMENT: Parent may add lenders, lead arrangers, bookrunners, or syndication agents to the debt financing syndicate after signing without triggering the Company-consent restriction on Commitment Letter amendments.

claim.raw_value: implement or exercise any “market flex” provisions contained in any related fee letters

attributes.why_unmapped: MARKET_FLEX: Parent may exercise market flex provisions in the fee letters to adjust financing terms without Company consent, and is not required to pay fees or rates above those set by such flex provisions.

claim.raw_value: reasonably cooperate with the marketing efforts for any Financing, including using reasonable best efforts to ensure that any syndication efforts with respect to such Financing benefit from the Company’s and its Subsidiaries’ existing lender and investor relationships

attributes.why_unmapped: MARKETING_PERIOD: Company's cooperation obligation extends to supporting syndication and marketing efforts by leveraging its existing lender and investor relationships.

claim.raw_value: Parent shall, promptly upon request by the Company, reimburse the Company or cause the Company to be reimbursed for all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket costs and expenses (including any commitment fee or other fee and including attorneys’ fees) incurred by the Company or any of its Subsidiaries in connection with such cooperation.

attributes.why_unmapped: REIMBURSEMENT_OR_INDEMNITY: Parent must reimburse the Company's reasonable, documented out-of-pocket costs and fees incurred in providing financing cooperation.

claim.raw_value: Parent shall indemnify and hold harmless the Company, its Subsidiaries and their respective Representatives from and against any and all liabilities, losses, damages, claims, costs, expenses, awards, judgments and penalties suffered or incurred by them in connection with the arrangement of any such Financing and/or any Debt Offer

attributes.why_unmapped: REIMBURSEMENT_OR_INDEMNITY: Parent indemnifies the Company, its Subsidiaries and Representatives against liabilities arising from arranging the Financing or any Debt Offer, subject to carve-outs for Company misstatements, bad faith, willful misconduct, gross negligence or material breach.
